    - **Tancred**. I mended the old drains under these quarters for thirty years, side by side with [Ida](../npcs/ida.md)'s father.
    - He drew the maps. I knew the water. Retired now, they tell me. So I keep the Steps Lane grating, and the sluice keys are still on my belt.
